summary: Wallowa County crow's nest from the 1930s, listed abandoned; 1936 panorama photos; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Crow's nest, per firelookout.com and the FFLA list
facts.status_note: Listed as abandoned by firelookout.com and the FFLA list. No source says whether anything remains.

events.note: Panorama photographs taken at the site on September 4, 1936 (Oregon list).

evidence.supports: Wallowa-Whitman National Forest named by firelookout.com
panorama photographs taken September 4, 1936; the only year printed on the Oregon list page
coordinates; Wallowa County; crow's nest; abandoned

corrections.why: The FFLA list gives Hen's status as Abandoned, not Gone, and firelookout.com also says abandoned. Neither source says the structure is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says Wallowa-Whitman National Forest; the Oregon list on Weebly says Wallowa National Forest. Both are cited. The record keeps Wallowa National Forest, which follows the Oregon list.

sources.title: Oregon Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Thin history: no build date, builder, staffing or removal date in any source read. The record's status gone is not supported; proposed unknown. Unread leads, seen only as search snippets: a National Archives at Seattle Facebook post mentions Hen Lookout alongside a 1954 Wallowa-Whitman forest photo, and an Alamy stock caption describes a 1936 panorama photo of a Hen Lookout tower, which conflicts with the crow's nest description. Read budget for this lookout is used up.
